Bornholm is a Danish municipality that is tracked in national healthcare quality reports for its management of atrial fibrillation (AF) patients. It is organized within the broader [[sundhedsklynger|Sundhedsklyngerne]] (health clusters) framework used for regional and local benchmarking [^src2]. 

In the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP), Bornholm's clinical outcomes are evaluated as part of a detailed breakdown covering all 98 Danish municipalities [^src1]. The municipality's data on stroke (apopleksi) events among AF patients is specifically incorporated into the DanStroke-based calculations for Indicator 5 [^src1]. This indicator measures the prevention of ischemic strokes through anticoagulation (AK) treatment [^src1]. The inclusion of Bornholm and other municipalities in this granular reporting underscores the AFDK report's role as a vital tool for local quality development and benchmarking within the Danish healthcare system [^src1].
